name: personal-futebol-mvp
description: Monorepo Evolui — SaaS para escolinhas; scripts na raiz para banco, Prisma e dev

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.prisma:sync: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run prisma:migrate:deploy --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.bootstrap: npm run install:all && npm run env && npm run db:up && npm run prisma:sync
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
